title: Autism prevalence by sex, 2022 (per 1,000 8-year-olds)

source.name: Autism and Developmental Disabilities Monitoring (ADDM) Network
source.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

notes: Boys were diagnosed at 49.2 per 1,000 vs. 14.3 per 1,000 for girls in the 2022 ADDM report — a 3.4x gap that researchers partly attribute to girls being under-identified by current screening tools.
